method:
LHA vs open-market value (OMV) by postcode sector and district, for Manchester, Cheltenham, Bristol.
Inputs: data/epc_full/epc_3cities_all.csv (latest EPC per home), data/ppd/*_2025-10_to_now.csv (Price Paid).
Output: data/ppd/lha_omv.json
Classes (rooms = habitable rooms on EPC): flat1 = flat, 2 rooms; flat2 = flat, 3 rooms; house2 = house, 3 rooms; house3 = house, 4 rooms.
